Step.title: Core Engine
Step.Explanation: The Core Engine is the heart of PrismQuanta. it manages the primary AI reasoning loops, processes high-level PQL commands, and coordinates between all other subsystems. In this view, you can monitor the engine's real-time generation and token usage.

Step.title: Ethical Gov
Step.Explanation: QuantaEthos provides a non-bypassable ethical validation layer. Every proposed action is reviewed against toxicity filters, bias scanners, and PII redactors. This view shows the current trust score and the results of the most recent safety checks.

Step.title: Model Backend
Step.Explanation: This view manages the connection to local LLM backends (like llama.cpp). It handles quantization settings, hardware acceleration (CUDA/Metal), and context window management to ensure optimal performance on local hardware.

Step.title: Sorrel Checker
Step.Explanation: Sorrel Driven Development (SDD) is the methodology used to build PrismQuanta. This panel runs the SDD engine to check the codebase for compliance with strict fact syntax, card coverage, and modularity rules.

Step.title: File
Step.Explanation: The File menu allows you to manage system configurations. You can load settings from a prismquanta.conf file or save your current session's changes back to disk for persistence.

Step.title: View Settings
Step.Explanation: Customize your TUI experience here. You can cycle through different ANSI color themes (Default, Emerald, Amber) and toggle the visibility of other menu modules to declutter your workspace.

Step.title: Export
Step.Explanation: Export your system state for external review. This menu provides tools to dump the current ConfigEngine state or the latest SDD Adherence Report into text files within the data directory.

Step.title: Sorrel Ops
Step.Explanation: Advanced SDD lifecycle operations. Use this menu to perform a full codebase compliance check or to initialize a new SDD environment (facts, cards, and restrictions) within a target directory.

Step.title: Plugins
Step.Explanation: PrismQuanta supports dynamic extensibility. This view scans the plugins directory for shared libraries and allows you to load them into the running system to add new reasoning capabilities.

Step.title: Data Analysis
Step.Explanation: Gain insights into system performance and SDD metrics. This dashboard displays the current SDD compliance score and provides telemetry on TUI rendering performance using the Benchmarker.
